summary: Provides typed visual references: ASSET preserves a subject, object, or scene identity, while STYLE transfers visual treatment such as color, lighting, and texture. This mode is different from pinning the first or last frame.
combines: Veo 3.1 and Veo 3.1 Fast accept up to three reference images; Veo 3.1 Lite does not support this mode.
Reference-image generation requires an eight-second duration and cannot be combined with source.image, config.lastFrame, or video extension.
Lixpi currently treats selected canvas images as first and last frames, so typed ASSET and STYLE conditioning remains absent until the UI can capture reference roles explicitly.
